plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically based on my private value. Since values are drawn independently and this is a one-shot game, I want to bid just below my true value to maximize potential profit. With a value of $46, I'll bid slightly under that to capture potential surplus if I win, while protecting against overpaying. A bid around $45.9 seems strategically sound.

In a first-price sealed bid auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid less than my true value. Since all bidders are rational, I'll aim to bid strategically below my $17 value. A good approach is to bid around 2/3 of my true value, which is approximately $11.33. This balances the risk of overbidding and the chance of winning the auction.

In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically based on my private value. Since the auction is winner-take-all, I want to maximize my expected profit. With a private value of $28, I'll bid slightly below this to ensure potential profit. A good strategy is to bid around 90% of my true value, which would be approximately $25.2. This allows room for potential profit if I win.
